observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black laptop with a Windows 11 desktop, red TrackPoint, ThinkPad logo on the palm rest, and an Intel Core i5 sticker on the lower left.
Photo 1: Closer front view showing the keyboard, TrackPoint, and the model name 'X380 Yoga' printed above the keyboard on the bezel. ThinkPad logo on the lower right of the palm rest.
Photo 2: Side view showing the laptop in tablet mode, held by a hand, with the screen flipped 180 degrees. The hinge mechanism is visible, and the screen bezel shows the Windows 11 interface.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI TOBA OSIBOTE'.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows 'X380 Yoga' printed above the keyboard, and the ThinkPad logo is visible in photos 0 and 1.
Photo 2 shows the laptop in tablet mode with the screen flipped 180 degrees, confirming the 360-degree hinge.
Photo 0 and 1 show an Intel Core i5 sticker on the lower left of the palm rest.
The Intel sticker shows 'Core i5' but does not specify the model number 8250U. No system information or BIOS screen is visible to confirm.
The desktop background and taskbar are consistent with Windows 11, but there is no visible system properties window or watermark to confirm it is Pro or 64-bit.
The text is cut off. No visible GPU information in the photos. The Intel sticker does not specify the graphics model.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the system properties window showing the OS version and architecture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if running Windows 10 or Home edition, which reduces value.

risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information or BIOS showing the exact CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has a lower-tier or different generation CPU, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The screen may have dead pixels, scratches, or hinge damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the screen under bright light and a detailed shot of the hinge mechanism.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the screen and hinge are in good condition, but with a discount for potential hidden defects.

risks.risk: The laptop may have physical damage or wear not visible in the current photos, such as dents, cracks, or keyboard issues.
risks.proof: A 360-degree video or multiple close-up photos of all sides, including the bottom, ports, and keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if in good condition, but with a discount for potential unseen wear.

proof_requests: Screenshot of system properties showing Windows 11 Pro 64-bit.
Screenshot of system information showing the exact CPU model (Intel Core i5-8250U).
Close-up video or photos of the screen under bright light to check for dead pixels or scratches.
360-degree video or photos of the laptop, including the bottom, ports, and hinge mechanism.
response.reason: The model and brand are confirmed, but key claims about the CPU model, OS version, and graphics are unverified. Hidden risks related to screen condition, hinge, and physical damage cannot be assessed from current photos. Proof is needed to confirm specifications and condition before pricing.
